items.titleOriginal: TAPR: Enhancing LLM Performance with a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28657v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often require carefully crafted prompts to unlock their full potential, which can be a barrier for non-expert users. This work addresses the challenge by introducing a Task-Aware Prompt Rewriter (TAPR), a model that reformulates user prompts into task-optimized prompts with the explicit goal of improving downstream LLM performance. We train TAPR using reinforcement learning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), where rewards are derived from LLM-as-judge evaluations of both the reformulated prompt and the corresponding task output. Experimental results on diverse tasks, such as question answering, summarization, and arithmetic reasoning, show that our method yields consistent gains over base models in prompt rewriting ability. Fine-tuning Phi-4-mini-instruct (as the base model for TAPR) produces prompts that contain clearer and more instructive language, leading to higher accuracy on established benchmarks such as Natural Questions and GSM8K. Our code is available at: https://github.com/OliverSavolainen/task-specific-prompt-rewriter
items.author: Oliver Savolainen, Emanuele Bastianelli, Hosein Azarbonyad
items.importanceReasonZh: 该研究提出了一种新的提示重写方法，通过强化学习优化提示，以提高LLM在多种任务上的性能，具有实际应用价值。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28659v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cross-domain sequential recommendation (CDSR) aims to model users' dynamic interest transitions and sequential patterns across multiple domains. Recently, generative recommendation (GR) has emerged. It first learns semantic identifiers (SIDs) from item semantics and formulates recommendation as autoregressive generation. However, existing methods face two critical issues: (1) they ignore collaborative correlations across domains during tokenization, and (2) they adopt inefficient decoding strategies, such as beam search, during generation, which hinders real-time deployment. items.detailZh:
跨域序列推荐（CDSR）旨在利用用户在不同域中的交互历史来建模其动态兴趣和序列模式。近年来，生成式推荐（GR）方法通过将物品表示为语义标识符（SID），并将推荐任务转化为自回归生成任务，取得了显著进展。然而，现有GR方法在CDSR中存在两个主要缺陷：首先，在分词阶段，它们通常独立处理每个域，忽略了跨域的协同相关性，导致生成的SID无法充分捕捉跨域共享信息；其次，在解码阶段，它们常采用束搜索等低效策略，导致推理延迟高，难以满足实时推荐需求。

为了解决这些问题，论文提出了GenCDSR框架。该框架包含两个核心组件：一是跨域混合分词机制，采用多塔架构，通过层次化的共享-特定码本和细粒度码本，联合学习跨域共性和域特定差异，从而生成更具表达力的SID；二是跨域串并行解码策略，利用SID的层次结构，将生成过程部分并行化，在保持生成质量的同时显著降低推理延迟。实验结果表明，GenCDSR在多个跨域推荐数据集上取得了优于现有方法的性能，同时推理速度大幅提升。
keyPointsZh: 提出GenCDSR，一个用于跨域序列推荐的生成式框架。
设计跨域混合分词机制，通过多塔架构和层次化码本捕获跨域共性和域特定差异。
开发跨域串并行解码策略，利用SID层次结构部分并行化生成，降低推理延迟。
在多个数据集上验证了GenCDSR的有效性和效率。
items.impactZh: 该研究对跨域推荐系统领域具有重要影响。对于开发者而言，GenCDSR提供了一种高效且有效的生成式推荐方案，能够显著降低推理延迟，有利于实时推荐系统的部署。对于行业而言，该框架能够更好地利用跨域数据，提升推荐准确性和用户满意度。此外，其混合分词和串并行解码思想也可为其他生成式任务提供借鉴。

items.titleOriginal: An Ontology-Guided, Deduplication-Aware Extraction Layer for Knowledge Graph Construction from Heterogeneous Documents
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28662v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models extract entities and relationships from unstructured documents fluently but inconsistently: type vocabularies fracture across documents, the same person surfaces under several name variants, relationships duplicate, and distinct individuals who share a name risk silent conflation. This paper presents the design, implementation, and empirical refinement of a production extraction layer that converts a live document stream into a validated knowledge graph aligned to a formal ontology. The system consumes document metadata from Kafka, routes PDF, spreadsheet, Office, and image content through handlers built for each format, and extracts entities and relationships in two passes using a locally hosted Qwen3.5-9B model tuned on the ontology. Its distinguishing component is ontology-guided extraction: the relevant slice of a curated ontology is retrieved live from a graph database by embedding similarity and injected into the extraction prompt, reducing catalog overhead by about 94 percent relative to static domain slices. items.author: Vaibhav Dangaich, Kevin Lewis, Kundeshwar Pundalik

items.titleEn: An Ontology-Guided, Deduplication-Aware Extraction Layer for Knowledge Graph Construction from Heterogeneous Documents
items.summaryZh: 本文介绍了一个生产级抽取层的设计与实现，该层将实时文档流转换为与正式本体对齐的知识图谱。系统通过Kafka消费文档元数据，处理PDF、电子表格、Office和图像等格式，并使用本地托管的Qwen3.5-9B模型进行两遍抽取。其核心是本体引导的抽取：通过嵌入相似度从图数据库实时检索相关本体片段并注入提示，将目录开销减少约94%。抽取结果经过五阶段精炼流程，包括确定性清洗和去重。
items.summaryEn: This paper presents the design and implementation of a production extraction layer that converts a live document stream into a knowledge graph aligned to a formal ontology. The system consumes document metadata from Kafka, handles PDF, spreadsheet, Office, and image formats, and extracts entities and relationships in two passes using a locally hosted Qwen3.5-9B model. Its key feature is ontology-guided extraction: relevant ontology slices are retrieved live from a graph database by embedding similarity and injected into prompts, reducing catalog overhead by about 94%. Extracted results pass through a five-stage refinement pipeline including deterministic cleaning and deduplication.
items.detailZh: 该论文介绍了一个生产级抽取层，用于从异构文档流中构建知识图谱。系统架构包括：通过Kafka消费文档元数据，路由到针对PDF、电子表格、Office和图像格式的处理器，并使用本地托管的Qwen3.5-9B模型进行两遍抽取。其核心创新是本体引导的抽取：从图数据库中实时检索与文档相关的本体片段（通过嵌入相似度），并注入到抽取提示中，从而将目录开销减少约94%。抽取结果经过五阶段精炼流程，包括确定性清洗、去重等，以确保知识图谱的一致性和准确性。
keyPointsZh: 系统使用Kafka消费文档元数据，并针对不同格式（PDF、电子表格、Office、图像）设计处理器。
采用本地托管的Qwen3.5-9B模型进行两遍抽取，以提取实体和关系。
本体引导的抽取通过嵌入相似度从图数据库实时检索相关本体片段，减少94%的目录开销。
抽取结果经过五阶段精炼流程，包括确定性清洗和去重，以处理名称变体和重复关系。
items.impactZh: 该研究为知识图谱构建提供了一种可扩展的解决方案，通过本体引导和去重机制提高了抽取的一致性和准确性。对于处理大规模异构文档的组织，该方法可减少人工干预，提升知识图谱质量。

items.titleOriginal: How Hard Does It Think? Analyzing Step-Aware Reasoning Energy in LLM Chain-of-Thought Trajectories
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28674v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding how computational effort is allocated across individual chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning steps remains an open challenge: existing interpretability methods rely on output-level signals or collapse processing depth into a single trajectory-level scalar, leaving step-wise effort opaque. We propose Step-Aware Reasoning Energy (SARE), a geometric framework that quantifies effort at the granularity of individual CoT steps via Centered Kernel Alignment (CKA) between Gram matrices of token hidden states across adjacent transformer layers, capturing inter-token relational structure without requiring eigenvector alignment or cluster correspondence. SARE further contextualizes this energy within reasoning's semantic progression by modeling CoT trajectories as transitions among latent semantic states. items.detailZh:
该论文提出了一种名为SARE（Step-Aware Reasoning Energy）的框架，用于量化LLM思维链推理中每个步骤的计算努力。SARE利用中心核对齐（CKA）比较相邻Transformer层中token隐藏状态的Gram矩阵，从而捕获token间的关系结构，无需特征向量对齐或簇对应。这种方法能够以单个步骤的粒度量化推理能量，同时通过将CoT轨迹建模为潜在语义状态之间的转换，将能量与推理的语义进展联系起来。

在六个推理基准和三个开放权重LLM上的实验表明，推理能量在不同步骤类型上高度不均匀，表现出类似相变的转换，这些转换在轨迹级指标中不可见。此外，不正确的轨迹在关键推理节点表现出系统性较低的能量，表明SARE可以用于识别推理中的薄弱环节。基于SARE的特征在预测推理正确性方面匹配或超过了现有方法。

该研究为LLM推理过程提供了更细粒度的可解释性工具，有助于理解模型如何分配计算资源，并可能用于改进推理错误检测和模型调试。
keyPointsZh: 提出SARE框架，通过CKA量化LLM思维链中每个步骤的推理能量。
SARE无需特征向量对齐或簇对应，适用于任意Transformer模型。
在六个推理基准和三个开放权重LLM上验证，发现推理能量在步骤类型上高度不均匀。
不正确的轨迹在关键推理节点表现出系统性较低的能量。
基于SARE的特征在预测推理正确性方面匹配或超过现有方法。
items.impactZh: 对于研究人员，SARE提供了一种新的工具来深入分析LLM推理过程，有助于理解模型的计算资源分配和推理错误来源。对于开发者，SARE可以用于调试和改进推理模型，例如通过识别低能量步骤来定位潜在错误。对于行业，该框架可能促进更可靠的推理系统开发，特别是在需要可解释性的应用场景中。

items.titleOriginal: Reasoning in Real World Clinical Care: Why Large Language Models Are Not Yet Safe for Autonomous Clinical Decision Support
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28677v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM now pass medical licensing examinations and, in curated cases, can rival physicians at diagnostic reasoning. These developments have accelerated the use of LLMs for symptom assessment and clinical decision support in diagnostic and treatment guidance, administrative documentation, and rules-based alert enhancement. This Perspective concerns the most consequential of these applications: the autonomous triage of self-presenting, undifferentiated patients, with little or no clinician in the loop. For that task, the evidence of safety does not yet exist. The gap is not in medical knowledge but in the fidelity of clinical evaluation: a model optimized to continue the most probable text is not optimized to act safely when the safe answer is the improbable must-not-miss diagnosis. Safe triage is not the selection of the most likely diagnosis; it is a sequential decision under asymmetric cost, in which the single catastrophic miss outweighs many false alarms, and the decisive signal may be one the patient has not volunteered - and that the model has not been trained to seek. items.titleOriginal: ViSAGE: Constructing Self-Correcting Memories for Long-Form Video Understanding
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28678v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal agents operating in long-horizon environments must build and continually update multimedia memories to support entity-consistent, temporally grounded reasoning. However, existing agentic memory approaches often discard fine-grained dentity cues under aggressive compression and segment-wise processing. They also rely heavily on vector similarity retrieval, which can surface semantically related yet identity-mismatched evidence, leading to entity confusion, error propagation, and hallucinated answers. We propose ViSAGE, a multimodal agentic memory framework that constructs self-correcting, entity-centric memories. Specifically, ViSAGE anchors entity identity via cross-modal binding over long temporal ranges. It then applies bidirectional memory refinement to propagate delayed identity evidence, retroactively unifying historical records and improving future reasoning. items.summaryZh: arXiv:2607.28678v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：在长时间跨度环境中运行的多模态代理必须构建并持续更新多媒体记忆，以支持实体一致、时间基础的推理。然而，现有的代理记忆方法在激进压缩和分段处理下常常丢弃细粒度的身份线索。它们还严重依赖向量相似性检索，这可能返回语义相关但身份不匹配的证据，导致实体混淆、错误传播和幻觉答案。我们提出ViSAGE，一种多模态代理记忆框架，构建自校正、以实体为中心的记忆。具体来说，ViSAGE通过跨模态绑定在长时间范围内锚定实体身份。然后应用双向记忆细化来传播延迟的身份证据，追溯性地统一历史记录并改善未来推理。我们还引入了多代理交叉验证，在身份证据对齐约束下评估检索到的证据，当证据缺失时能够弃权而不是给出无根据的答案。大量结果表明ViSAGE持续优于现有方法。

items.detailZh: 该论文介绍了一种名为ViSAGE的多模态代理记忆框架，旨在解决长视频理解中的关键挑战。现有方法在处理长时间跨度时，往往通过激进压缩和分段处理丢失细粒度的身份线索，导致实体混淆和错误传播。ViSAGE通过跨模态绑定在长时间范围内锚定实体身份，确保身份一致性。此外，它采用双向记忆细化机制，传播延迟的身份证据，追溯性地统一历史记录，从而改善未来推理。为了进一步提高可靠性，ViSAGE引入了多代理交叉验证，在身份证据对齐约束下评估检索到的证据，当证据不足时允许模型弃权而非给出无根据的答案。实验结果表明，ViSAGE在多个基准上持续优于现有方法，展示了其在长视频理解任务中的有效性。
keyPointsZh: ViSAGE通过跨模态绑定在长时间范围内锚定实体身份，解决身份丢失问题。
采用双向记忆细化机制，传播延迟身份证据，统一历史记录。
引入多代理交叉验证，在证据不足时支持弃权，减少幻觉。
实验证明ViSAGE在长视频理解任务上优于现有方法。
items.impactZh: 该研究对多模态代理和长视频理解领域具有重要影响。它提供了一种构建自校正记忆的方法，能够提高实体一致性和推理准确性，减少错误传播。对于开发人员，ViSAGE的框架可以集成到现有的多模态系统中，提升处理长视频任务的能力。对于行业，该技术有望应用于视频分析、智能监控和人机交互等领域，提高系统的可靠性和实用性。

items.titleOriginal: Multi-Agent Planning with Spatio-Temporal and Topological Constraints using STL-GO
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28679v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multi-agent planning problems arise in a variety of engineering applications, such as multi-robot wildfire fighting and unmanned aerial inspection in factories. A particular challenge is the existence of spatio-temporal (i.e., when and/or where an agent should do what) and topological constraints (i.e., how agents should interact), as typically formalized via the notion of graphs. Over the last years, various frameworks have been proposed that can capture such constraints via spatio-temporal logics. We focus here on spatio-temporal logic with graph operators (STL-GO), a recent formalism that supports reasoning about multiple agents and their topologies, such as sensing, communication, and task topologies. In this paper, we consider the problem of planning multi-agent paths that satisfy constraints written in STL-GO. This problem is particularly challenging due to the need of encoding multiple, potentially time-varying graphs via the graph operators inherent to STL-GO. We present two encodings of this problem, one based on mixed-integer programming (MIP) and another based on satisfiability modulo theory (SMT), with soundness guarantees
items.author: Sheryl Paul, Vidisha Kudalkar, Anand Balakrishnan, Lars Lindemann, Alberto Speranzon, Jyotirmoy V. Deshmukh

items.titleZh: 使用STL-GO的多智能体规划：时空与拓扑约束
items.titleEn: Multi-Agent Planning with Spatio-Temporal and Topological Constraints using STL-GO
items.summaryZh: 本文研究了多智能体路径规划问题，其中需满足时空约束（何时何地执行动作）和拓扑约束（智能体间交互）。作者聚焦于时空逻辑STL-GO，该逻辑支持图算子以表达多智能体拓扑。他们提出了两种编码方法：混合整数规划（MIP）和可满足性模理论（SMT），并提供了可靠性保证。
items.summaryEn: This paper addresses multi-agent path planning with spatio-temporal and topological constraints, formalized using STL-GO logic. The authors propose two encodings: mixed-integer programming (MIP) and satisfiability modulo theory (SMT), with soundness guarantees.
items.detailZh:
多智能体规划问题在工程应用中广泛存在，如多机器人灭火、工厂无人机巡检等。这些场景中，智能体需要满足时空约束（何时何地执行动作）和拓扑约束（智能体间的交互关系）。近年来，研究者提出了多种时空逻辑来形式化这些约束。本文聚焦于STL-GO，一种支持图算子的时空逻辑，能够表达多智能体拓扑（如感知、通信、任务拓扑）。

本文研究了满足STL-GO约束的多智能体路径规划问题。该问题的难点在于STL-GO的图算子需要编码多个可能随时间变化的图。作者提出了两种编码方法：基于混合整数规划（MIP）和基于可满足性模理论（SMT），并提供了可靠性保证。

论文发表于arXiv，属于理论性研究，尚未提供实验验证或实际应用案例。
keyPointsZh: 提出使用STL-GO逻辑形式化多智能体规划中的时空和拓扑约束。
设计了两种编码方法：MIP和SMT，用于求解满足STL-GO约束的路径。
提供了编码的可靠性保证。
研究处于理论阶段，缺乏实验验证。
items.impactZh: 该研究为多智能体规划提供了新的理论框架，可能推动相关应用的发展，如多机器人协作、无人机巡检等。但实际影响需待实验验证和工程实现。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing benchmarks for scientific equation discovery are largely composed of well-known equations available in the public domain, making it difficult to determine whether a model is discovering laws from data or merely recalling answers from its training corpus. LSR-Synth mitigates this problem by introducing novel synthetic terms into established scientific mechanisms and filtering the resulting tasks for novelty, solvability, and scientific plausibility. This paper examines a narrower measurement question: can these tasks further distinguish scientific priors supplied by language models from conventional operator search that does not access task semantics? items.summaryZh: arXiv:2607.28684v1 新论文摘要：现有的科学方程发现基准大多由公共领域的知名方程组成，难以判断模型是从数据中发现规律还是从训练语料中回忆答案。LSR-Synth通过将新颖的合成项引入既有科学机制，并过滤出具有新颖性、可解性和科学合理性的任务来缓解这一问题。本文研究一个更窄的测量问题：这些任务能否进一步区分语言模型提供的科学先验与不访问任务语义的常规算子搜索？作者使用固定词汇和公开记录来源构建了无语义基线，并通过语义盲化、库弱化和匹配算子族剔除来评估候选覆盖的作用。在当前任务快照、搜索预算和评分协议下，固定词汇已覆盖大多数任务，而语言模型生成的候选很少扩展可解实例集。其边际贡献仅在特定条件下变得显著。
items.summaryEn: arXiv:2607.28684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Existing benchmarks for scientific equation discovery are largely composed of well-known equations available in the public domain, making it difficult to determine whether a model is discovering laws from data or merely recalling answers from its training corpus. LSR-Synth mitigates this problem by introducing novel synthetic terms into established scientific mechanisms and filtering the resulting tasks for novelty, solvability, and scientific plausibility. This paper examines a narrower measurement question: can these tasks further distinguish scientific priors supplied by language models from conventional operator search that does not access task semantics? We construct a semantics-free baseline using a fixed vocabulary with publicly docume
items.detailZh: 该论文针对现有科学方程发现基准的缺陷，即大多由公开已知方程组成，导致模型可能通过记忆训练数据而非真正从数据中学习规律。为此，作者提出了LSR-Synth基准，通过引入新颖的合成项并过滤任务，确保任务具有新颖性、可解性和科学合理性。本文进一步探讨了这些任务能否区分语言模型提供的科学先验与不依赖任务语义的常规算子搜索。作者构建了一个使用固定词汇和公开来源的无语义基线，并通过语义盲化、库弱化和匹配算子族剔除等方法评估候选覆盖的作用。实验结果表明，在当前任务快照、搜索预算和评分协议下，固定词汇已覆盖大多数任务，而语言模型生成的候选很少扩展可解实例集，其边际贡献仅在特定条件下显著。
keyPointsZh: 现有符号发现基准多由公开已知方程组成，存在记忆化风险。
LSR-Synth通过引入新颖合成项并过滤任务来缓解记忆化问题。
作者构建了无语义基线，并评估了语言模型候选的边际贡献。
固定词汇已覆盖大多数任务，语言模型候选的扩展有限。
items.impactZh: 该研究对AI科学发现领域有重要影响，提醒研究者注意模型记忆化问题，并提供了新的评估方法。对于开发者和研究人员，这意味着在设计基准和评估模型时，需要更加注重任务的新颖性和模型的泛化能力。

items.titleOriginal: Quoting Steve Yegge
items.summaryOriginal: Gas Town was intended to be reusable, but I only ever wound up using it to build itself. Gas Town fell apart at the seams with Opus 4.7. Up through 4.6 it was working brilliantly. With 4.7 we saw the introduction of the "just two more things" tic, which prevented Opus from ever converging on being ready to do real work—it always wanted to fiddle with Gas Town itself. The Opus tic never went away, so Gas Town effectively burned down. It had other problems, too, but 4.7 was the final straw. — Steve Yegge , The Shape of Things to Come Tags: steve-yegge , coding-agents , generative-ai , ai , llms

items.summaryZh: Steve Yegge 在《The Shape of Things to Come》中评论说，他的 Gas Town 项目本意是可复用的，但最终只用于构建自身。在 Opus 4.7 之前一直运行良好，但 4.7 引入了“再来两件事”的怪癖，导致 Opus 无法收敛到可完成实际工作的状态，总是想调整 Gas Town 本身。这个怪癖从未消失，最终导致 Gas Town 项目失败。

It worked well until Opus 4.7, which introduced a 'just two more things' tic that prevented Opus from converging on real work, always wanting to fiddle with Gas Town itself. The tic never went away, effectively burning down Gas Town.
items.detailZh: Steve Yegge 在《The Shape of Things to Come》中分享了他使用 AI 编码代理 Opus 构建 Gas Town 项目的经历。Gas Town 最初被设计为可复用的工具，但实际使用中，它只被用来构建自身。在 Opus 4.6 及之前版本，一切运行良好。然而，从 Opus 4.7 开始，模型出现了一种“再来两件事”的倾向，即总是提出额外的修改要求，导致项目无法收敛到完成实际工作的状态。这种倾向持续存在，最终导致 Gas Town 项目失败。Yegge 指出，除了这个问题，项目还有其他问题，但 4.7 版本是压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。
keyPointsZh: Gas Town 项目本意是可复用的，但最终只用于构建自身。
Opus 4.7 引入了“再来两件事”的怪癖，导致模型无法收敛。
该怪癖从未消失，最终导致 Gas Town 项目失败。
Yegge 认为 4.7 是最终原因，但项目还有其他问题。
items.impactZh: 对于使用 AI 编码代理的开发者，此评论提示了模型版本更新可能引入的行为变化，可能导致项目无法完成。建议在升级模型版本时进行充分测试，并关注模型是否出现类似的“无限修改”倾向。

items.detailZh: Video-DeepResearch（Video-DR）是一项将多模态智能体从静态图像扩展到连续视频流的研究。传统深度研究智能体主要处理文本和图像，而视频包含动态时序信息，对智能体的感知和推理能力提出更高要求。该研究提出解耦感知-探索流水线，将感知和探索过程分离，以减轻模态偏差（即模型过度依赖某一模态信息）的问题。同时，采用分阶段工具解锁策略，逐步开放工具使用权限，避免参数知识泄漏（即模型在训练时可能记住某些答案，导致评估不准确）。这些方法旨在提升智能体在视频理解任务中的鲁棒性和泛化能力。然而，目前公开信息仅来自论文摘要，未提供具体实验数据、基准测试结果或与现有方法的对比，因此其实际效果和贡献有待进一步验证。
keyPointsZh: Video-DR将多模态智能体从静态图像扩展到连续视频流。
提出解耦感知-探索流水线以应对模态偏差。
采用分阶段工具解锁策略防止参数知识泄漏。
目前仅有论文摘要，缺乏实验细节和验证。
items.impactZh: 该研究可能推动视频理解智能体的发展，为处理动态视觉信息提供新思路。对于开发者而言，解耦感知-探索和分阶段工具解锁的方法可借鉴到其他多模态任务中。但需等待完整论文和实验数据，以评估其实际效果。

items.titleOriginal: Any-OPD：面向流匹配模型的异构同策略蒸馏框架
items.summaryOriginal: Any-OPD 提出首个支持任意异构流匹配生成器对的同策略蒸馏框架，仅通过冻结的 DINOv2 表示空间桥接教师与学生模型，无需共享 VAE、架构或噪声调度。将 FLUX.1-dev 蒸馏至 SD3.5-Medium 后，学生模型 PickScore 与 HPSv3 均显著提升，以教师五分之一的参数量达到接近其性能，而直接潜在回归训练完全失败。

items.titleZh: Any-OPD：面向流匹配模型的异构同策略蒸馏框架
items.titleEn: Any-OPD: Heterogeneous On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models
items.summaryZh: Any-OPD 提出首个支持任意异构流匹配生成器对的同策略蒸馏框架，仅通过冻结的 DINOv2 表示空间桥接教师与学生模型，无需共享 VAE、架构或噪声调度。将 FLUX.1-dev 蒸馏至 SD3.5-Medium 后，学生模型 PickScore 与 HPSv3 均显著提升，以教师五分之一的参数量达到接近其性能，而直接潜在回归训练完全失败。
items.summaryEn: Any-OPD proposes the first on-policy distillation framework that supports arbitrary heterogeneous flow matching generator pairs, bridging teacher and student models solely through a frozen DINOv2 representation space, without requiring shared VAE, architecture, or noise schedule. Distilling FLUX.1-dev to SD3.5-Medium, the student model significantly improves PickScore and HPSv3, achieving near-teacher performance with one-fifth the parameters, while direct latent regression training completely fails.
items.detailZh:
Any-OPD 是一种针对流匹配模型的同策略蒸馏框架，其核心创新在于支持任意异构的教师-学生生成器对。传统蒸馏方法通常要求教师和学生共享相同的 VAE、架构或噪声调度，这限制了蒸馏的灵活性。Any-OPD 通过使用冻结的 DINOv2 表示空间作为桥接，使得教师和学生可以在完全不同的潜在空间中操作，从而无需共享任何组件。

在实验中，作者将 FLUX.1-dev 蒸馏到 SD3.5-Medium，学生模型在 PickScore 和 HPSv3 指标上均显著提升，以教师五分之一的参数量达到了接近教师的性能。相比之下，直接进行潜在回归训练完全失败，表明该方法在异构设置下的有效性。

该框架的提出为模型压缩和知识迁移提供了新的可能性，尤其是在资源受限的环境中，可以利用强大的教师模型来提升小型学生模型的能力，而无需受限于架构兼容性。
keyPointsZh: Any-OPD 支持任意异构流匹配生成器对的同策略蒸馏。
仅使用冻结的 DINOv2 表示空间桥接教师和学生，无需共享 VAE、架构或噪声调度。
将 FLUX.1-dev 蒸馏至 SD3.5-Medium，学生模型 PickScore 和 HPSv3 显著提升。
学生模型参数量为教师的五分之一，性能接近教师。
直接潜在回归训练完全失败，凸显异构蒸馏的挑战。
items.impactZh: 该研究为模型蒸馏领域提供了新的思路，使得在异构架构之间进行知识迁移成为可能。对于开发者而言，这意味着可以利用高性能的闭源或大型模型来蒸馏出更小、更高效的模型，而无需担心架构匹配问题。这有助于在资源受限的设备上部署高性能生成模型，并可能推动生成模型在移动端和边缘设备上的应用。

items.detailZh: 科技巨头高管普遍表示算力供应仍无法满足需求，但AI定价却在上涨。Anthropic于7月24日发布的Fable 5定价每百万输出token 50美元，较Opus 5翻倍；OpenAI则在Fable 5发布五天后将GPT-5.6 Luna价格下调80%。这种定价分层现象引发了对杰文斯悖论持续性的讨论。杰文斯悖论指出，效率提升会导致资源消耗增加而非减少。在AI领域，算力效率的提升可能反而刺激了更多需求，但定价上涨可能抑制需求。文章分析了这种矛盾现象背后的市场逻辑。

OpenAI在Fable 5发布五天后将GPT-5.6 Luna价格下调80%。
科技巨头高管普遍表示算力供应仍无法满足需求。
AI定价上涨与算力需求增长并存，引发杰文斯悖论是否持续的讨论。
items.impactZh: 对于AI开发者和企业用户，定价分层意味着不同模型的选择将直接影响成本。高端模型如Fable 5价格翻倍，可能促使部分用户转向性价比更高的模型。同时，OpenAI的大幅降价可能加剧市场竞争，推动AI应用普及。对于行业而言，定价策略的差异化反映了市场对算力资源的重新评估，可能影响未来的模型研发方向。

items.summaryOriginal: Don't be a meat proxy Niklas Gruhn coins an excellent new term - meat proxy - for people who blindly copy and paste the output of AI systems to their peers. By all means, prompt AI. But don't just relay the output. Read it, understand it, validate it, and then write a response in your own words (a decent certificate that you've done the prior steps). items.titleOriginal: EA 首席战略官谈生成式 AI 如何进入可游玩的实时游戏世界
items.summaryOriginal: EA 首席战略官 Mihir Vaidya 认为，游戏是 AI 的试验场，但生成式 AI 进入游戏面临 60 帧/秒、数千玩家同步和低延迟等严苛约束，不能只追求"看起来真实"，而必须"行为正确"。他主张采用神经符号架构，在生成能力之外保留确定性与可控性，并称"控制是下一个前沿"。EA 将 AI 影响分为效率、扩展和转型三个层面，其中《模拟人生》已服务超 5 亿玩家，拥有近万亿种游玩排列组合。

items.titleEn: EA Chief Strategy Officer on How Generative AI Enters Playable Real-Time Game Worlds
items.summaryZh: EA 首席战略官 Mihir Vaidya 认为，游戏是 AI 的试验场，但生成式 AI 进入游戏面临 60 帧/秒、数千玩家同步和低延迟等严苛约束，不能只追求"看起来真实"，而必须"行为正确"。他主张采用神经符号架构，在生成能力之外保留确定性与可控性，并称"控制是下一个前沿"。EA 将 AI 影响分为效率、扩展和转型三个层面，其中《模拟人生》已服务超 5 亿玩家，拥有近万亿种游玩排列组合。
items.summaryEn: EA's Chief Strategy Officer Mihir Vaidya believes games are a testing ground for AI, but generative AI entering games faces strict constraints like 60 frames per second, thousands of players syncing, and low latency. It cannot just look realistic but must behave correctly. He advocates a neuro-symbolic architecture that retains determinism and controllability alongside generative capabilities, calling 'control' the next frontier. EA categorizes AI impact into efficiency, expansion, and transformation, with The Sims serving over 500 million players and offering nearly a trillion play permutations.
items.detailZh: Vaidya 将 AI 对游戏的影响分为三个层面：效率（提升开发效率）、扩展（扩大游戏内容规模）和转型（改变游戏玩法）。他以《模拟人生》为例，该游戏已服务超 5 亿玩家，拥有近万亿种游玩排列组合，展示了 AI 在扩展游戏内容方面的潜力。但他也指出，生成式 AI 在实时游戏中的应用仍面临技术挑战，需要平衡生成质量与性能。
keyPointsZh: 生成式 AI 在游戏中需满足 60 帧/秒、数千玩家同步和低延迟等实时约束。
AI 生成内容必须"行为正确"，而非仅"看起来真实"。
EA 主张采用神经符号架构，结合生成能力与确定性、可控性。
EA 将 AI 影响分为效率、扩展和转型三个层面。
《模拟人生》服务超 5 亿玩家，拥有近万亿种游玩排列组合。
items.impactZh: 对游戏开发者而言，该观点提示生成式 AI 的应用需考虑实时性能和可控性，神经符号架构可能成为重要方向。对行业而言，EA 的立场表明大型游戏公司正在探索 AI 的实用化路径，而非仅停留在概念验证。

items.summaryEn: AWS now allows vibe-coding tool Superblocks to be embedded into the private clouds of AWS customers. It's another step toward decoupling apps from models.
items.detailZh:
根据TechCrunch AI的报道，AWS现在允许vibe-coding工具Superblocks嵌入到AWS客户的私有云中。这一举措标志着AWS在支持新兴AI开发工具方面迈出了重要一步，同时也反映了行业趋势：应用开发正在与底层模型解耦。Superblocks是一家专注于vibe-coding的初创公司，其工具允许开发者通过自然语言描述来生成应用程序，而无需深入掌握传统编程。此次合作意味着Superblocks的工具可以在AWS的私有云环境中运行，为AWS客户提供更灵活、更安全的AI应用开发选项。

报道指出，这一合作是AWS在AI领域持续布局的一部分，旨在吸引更多使用AI辅助开发的客户。通过将Superblocks嵌入私有云，AWS客户可以在自己的基础设施上使用该工具，从而更好地控制数据安全和合规性。此外，这也表明AWS正在积极拥抱vibe-coding这一新兴趋势，尽管该术语在业界仍存在争议。

然而，报道并未提供具体的合作条款、技术细节或客户案例，因此关于该合作的更多信息仍有待披露。

items.titleOriginal: 欧盟《人工智能法案》透明度规则生效，违规最高罚 1500 万欧元
items.summaryOriginal: 欧盟《人工智能法案》下的新透明度义务于 8 月 2 日生效，要求公司披露用户何时与 AI 模型互动，并为合成音视频和文本添加机器可读标记。欧盟还推出了一套可选的 AI 披露标签供平台采用，但标注要求本身是强制性的。违规公司面临最高 1500 万欧元（约 1720 万美元）或全球年营业额 3% 的罚款，8 月 2 日前推出的模型有 4 个月宽限期。
items.author: The Verge：AI（RSS）

items.titleEn: EU AI Act Transparency Rules Take Effect, Fines Up to €15 Million
items.summaryZh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》下的新透明度义务于 8 月 2 日生效，要求公司披露用户何时与 AI 模型互动，并为合成音视频和文本添加机器可读标记。欧盟还推出了一套可选的 AI 披露标签供平台采用，但标注要求本身是强制性的。违规公司面临最高 1500 万欧元（约 1720 万美元）或全球年营业额 3% 的罚款，8 月 2 日前推出的模型有 4 个月宽限期。
items.summaryEn: New transparency obligations under the EU AI Act took effect on August 2, requiring companies to disclose when users interact with AI models and add machine-readable markings to synthetic audio, video, and text. The EU also introduced a set of optional AI disclosure labels for platforms to adopt, but the labeling requirements themselves are mandatory. Non-compliant companies face fines up to €15 million (about $17.2 million) or 3% of global annual turnover, with a 4-month grace period for models launched before August 2.
items.detailZh: 欧盟《人工智能法案》的透明度规则于 2026 年 8 月 2 日正式生效。这些规则要求 AI 公司向用户明确披露他们何时在与 AI 模型互动，并为合成音视频和文本添加机器可读标记。欧盟委员会还推出了一套可选的 AI 披露标签，供平台自愿采用，但标注要求本身是强制性的。违规公司可能面临最高 1500 万欧元（约 1720 万美元）或全球年营业额 3% 的罚款，以较高者为准。对于在 8 月 2 日前推出的模型，有 4 个月的宽限期。
keyPointsZh: 透明度义务于 8 月 2 日生效，要求披露 AI 互动和标记合成内容。
欧盟推出可选 AI 披露标签，但标注要求是强制性的。
违规罚款最高 1500 万欧元或全球年营业额 3%。
8 月 2 日前推出的模型有 4 个月宽限期。
items.impactZh: 对于在欧盟运营的 AI 公司，需要立即调整产品以符合透明度要求，包括添加披露信息和机器可读标记。这可能导致合规成本增加，但有助于建立用户信任。对于开发者，需要关注技术实现，如元数据标记。对于行业，可能推动全球 AI 透明度标准的形成。
actionStepsZh: 审查现有 AI 产品，确保符合透明度要求。

items.titleOriginal: IBM finds 92% of companies hit by AI security breaches lacked basic access controls
items.summaryOriginal: According to IBM, 92 percent of companies that experienced an AI security incident had inadequate access controls for their AI systems. The model itself was rarely the problem. The article IBM finds 92% of companies hit by AI security breaches lacked basic access controls appeared first on The Decoder .
items.author: Thomas Joos
items.importanceReasonZh: 该新闻提供了关于AI安全事件中访问控制重要性的具体统计数据，对企业安全实践有指导意义。
items.importanceReasonEn: The news provides specific statistics on the importance of access control in AI security incidents, which is instructive for enterprise security practices.
items.titleZh: IBM发现92%遭遇AI安全事件的公司缺乏基本访问控制
items.titleEn: IBM finds 92% of companies hit by AI security breaches lacked basic access controls
items.summaryZh: 根据IBM的数据，92%遭遇AI安全事件的公司对其AI系统缺乏足够的访问控制。问题很少出在模型本身。
items.summaryEn: According to IBM, 92 percent of companies that experienced an AI security incident had inadequate access controls for their AI systems. The model itself was rarely the problem.
items.detailZh:
IBM发布了一份报告，指出在遭遇AI安全事件的公司中，有92%的公司对其AI系统缺乏足够的访问控制。这意味着大多数安全漏洞并非源于AI模型本身的缺陷，而是由于企业未能实施基本的访问管理措施。报告强调，访问控制是保护AI系统安全的第一道防线，但许多企业忽视了这一点。

该报告基于对多个行业公司的调查，发现许多公司在部署AI时，没有充分考虑到安全访问控制的重要性。这导致敏感数据泄露、模型被篡改或滥用等风险。IBM建议企业应优先加强访问控制，包括身份验证、权限管理和监控，以降低AI安全风险。
keyPointsZh: 92%的AI安全事件与访问控制不足有关。
AI模型本身很少是安全问题的根源。
企业需要加强访问控制以保护AI系统。
items.impactZh: 对于企业而言，这一发现提醒他们在部署AI时，必须将安全访问控制作为首要任务，否则可能面临数据泄露和系统被滥用的风险。对于安全行业，这强调了访问控制工具和最佳实践的重要性。
actionStepsZh: 审查并加强AI系统的访问控制策略。
实施多因素身份验证和权限管理。
定期监控AI系统的访问日志。

items.titleOriginal: Devtools must be open source (exe.dev)
items.summaryOriginal: My comment on Devtools must be open source (exe.dev) — Hacker News. One of the arguments for open source software for end-users has always been the freedom to examine and modify how that software works. The reality for most people - even expert programmers - has been that the freedom is more about being able to lean on other people to do that. Most people can't justify the time commitment needed to read and then modify the code for tools they use very often. I think LLMs have changed that equation in a way that makes the original dream much more feasible. Several times a day I'll prompt regular Claude chat to "Clone x/y from GitHub and tell me how Z works". Getting software to compile in order to start hacking on it used to be enough friction that I often wouldn't bother. Now I treat that as a zero time investment challenge: tell Codex or Claude Code to checkout and build X and then come back ten minutes later and see how it got on. I'm not habitually modifying the software I use yet, but I can see a path to that which didn't exist a year or so ago. Tags: hacker-news , open-source , ai , generative-ai , llms , ai-assisted-programming
items.importanceReasonZh: 该观点反映了AI对开发者工作流的实际影响，具有实践指导意义，但属于个人经验分享，缺乏系统性证据。
items.importanceReasonEn: The opinion reflects the practical impact of AI on developer workflows, offering actionable insights, but it is based on personal experience and lacks systematic evidence.

items.summaryEn: The author comments on Hacker News that LLMs have changed the accessibility of open source software, making the original dream of examining and modifying code more feasible. The friction of compiling and modifying code has been reduced by AI assistants like Codex and Claude Code, which can quickly clone, build, and understand code.
items.detailZh: 作者在Hacker News上对“开发者工具必须开源”的帖子发表评论。他指出，开源软件的传统优势在于用户可以自由检查和修改代码，但现实中大多数人（甚至专业程序员）很少真正去阅读和修改代码，因为时间成本太高。然而，LLM的出现改变了这一状况。作者提到，他每天多次使用Claude聊天来“从GitHub克隆x/y并告诉我Z是如何工作的”。过去，编译和修改代码的摩擦常常让他放弃，但现在他可以将此视为零时间投入的挑战：让Codex或Claude Code检出并构建项目，十分钟后回来查看进展。虽然作者尚未习惯性地修改软件，但他认为这条路已经变得可行，而一年前还不存在。
keyPointsZh: 开源软件的自由在于检查和修改代码，但现实中很少有人这样做。
LLM降低了阅读和理解代码的门槛，使得克隆和构建项目变得容易。
作者使用Claude、Codex等AI助手快速克隆和构建代码，节省时间。
作者认为AI辅助编程使得修改软件成为可能，但尚未形成习惯。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，AI辅助编程工具可以显著降低理解和修改开源代码的障碍，提高工作效率。对于开源社区，这可能促进更多人参与代码审查和贡献。对于AI行业，这展示了LLM在编程领域的实际应用价值。
actionStepsZh: 尝试使用AI助手（如Claude、Codex）克隆并构建你感兴趣的开源项目。
利用AI解释代码库的结构和关键功能，快速理解项目。
将AI辅助编程纳入日常开发流程，减少重复性工作。

items.titleOriginal: Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa
items.summaryOriginal: AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report. Financial losses more than doubled from $192 million to $484 million, and about 600,000 cases of digital extortion involving deepfakes were recorded. The article Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa appeared first on The Decoder .
items.author: Matthias Bastian
items.importanceReasonZh: 该报告提供了关于AI在非洲网络犯罪中作用的具体数据，对理解AI的负面影响和网络安全趋势有重要参考价值。
items.importanceReasonEn: The report provides concrete data on AI's role in cybercrime in Africa, which is important for understanding AI's negative impacts and cybersecurity trends.
items.titleZh: 国际刑警组织称人工智能已成为非洲网络犯罪的“核心操作驱动力”
items.titleEn: Interpol says AI has become the "core operational driver of cybercrime" across Africa
items.summaryZh: 根据国际刑警组织的一份新报告，人工智能参与了非洲55%的已报告网络犯罪。财务损失从1.92亿美元翻倍至4.84亿美元，并记录了约60万起涉及深度伪造的数字勒索案件。
items.summaryEn: AI is involved in 55 percent of reported cybercrimes in Africa, according to a new Interpol report. Financial losses more than doubled from $192 million to $484 million, and about 600,000 cases of digital extortion involving deepfakes were recorded.
items.detailZh: 国际刑警组织发布的一份新报告显示，人工智能已成为非洲网络犯罪的“核心操作驱动力”。报告指出，在非洲报告的55%的网络犯罪中，AI都参与其中。财务损失从1.92亿美元激增至4.84亿美元，翻了一倍多。此外，报告还记录了约60万起涉及深度伪造的数字勒索案件。这些数据凸显了AI技术在犯罪活动中的滥用，以及非洲地区在网络安全方面面临的严峻挑战。
keyPointsZh: AI参与了非洲55%的已报告网络犯罪。
财务损失从1.92亿美元增加到4.84亿美元。
记录了约60万起涉及深度伪造的数字勒索案件。
国际刑警组织将AI描述为网络犯罪的“核心操作驱动力”。
items.impactZh: 这一报告对非洲及全球的网络安全政策制定者、企业和个人都有重要影响。它提醒人们，AI技术不仅带来便利，也可能被用于犯罪活动。企业和个人需要加强网络安全防护，特别是对深度伪造和AI驱动的欺诈保持警惕。同时，政府和国际组织需要加强合作，制定相应的法规和应对措施。

模型为原生统一多模态，支持文本和图像处理。

items.summaryZh: 欢迎阅读Import AI，一份关于AI研究的通讯。Import AI依靠arXiv、卡布奇诺和读者的反馈运行。如果您想支持我们，请订阅。现在订阅：自我维持和自我复制的AI病毒已经出现：…开放权重LLM + 精心设计的框架 = 一种持久、自给自足的病毒…AI研究人员已经构建了一个原型计算机病毒，该病毒[……]

Subscribe now Self-sustaining and self-replicating AI viruses are here:…Open weight LLMs + a well-designed harness = a persistent, self-sufficient virus…AI researchers have built a prototype computer virus which […]
items.detailZh:
本期Import AI通讯重点报道了AI研究中的几个关键话题。首先，文章指出AI研究人员已经构建了一种原型计算机病毒，该病毒利用开放权重的大型语言模型（LLM）和精心设计的框架，能够实现自我维持和自我复制。这种病毒被称为“自我维持和自我复制的AI病毒”，其核心在于利用LLM的能力来生成新的攻击载荷或变异，从而绕过传统安全措施。文章强调，这种病毒的出现标志着AI安全领域面临新的挑战，因为开放权重模型使得恶意行为者更容易获取和利用这些技术。

其次，文章讨论了关于AI发展节奏的争议。一些专家认为，AI的发展速度过快，可能导致社会无法适应，因此需要“调整AI发展节奏”，即通过政策、伦理规范或技术手段来减缓AI的部署速度。这一观点与当前关于AI监管的讨论相呼应，但文章并未提供具体的政策建议或技术方案。

最后，文章提到了人们对AI与创造力的困惑。随着AI在艺术、写作等创造性领域的表现越来越强，人们开始质疑AI是否真正具备创造力，或者只是模仿人类创造力的表面特征。文章指出，这种困惑反映了公众对AI能力的误解，以及AI技术发展带来的哲学和伦理问题。

需要注意的是，本文为通讯文章，内容较为概括，缺乏详细的技术细节和具体案例，因此信息完整性有限。
keyPointsZh: AI研究人员构建了利用开放权重LLM的自我复制病毒原型。
开放权重模型降低了恶意使用AI技术的门槛。
关于AI发展节奏的讨论涉及政策、伦理和技术手段。
公众对AI创造力的理解存在困惑。
items.impactZh: 对于读者和开发者而言，这一报道提醒我们关注AI安全的重要性，尤其是在开放权重模型日益普及的背景下。对于行业而言，自我复制AI病毒的出现可能促使安全社区开发新的防御机制，并推动政策制定者考虑更严格的AI监管。此外，关于AI发展节奏和创造力的讨论可能影响公众对AI的接受度和信任度。

items.titleOriginal: Cloudflare Workers 与 Containers 现已支持入站 TCP 连接和 gRPC
items.summaryOriginal: Cloudflare 在 Agents Week 期间推出 Workers 运行时新处理器 connect（socket），可直接接受 Spectrum 提供的入站 TCP 套接字，并支持将套接字转发至 Durable Objects 或 Containers，实现全双工通信。
items.author: Cloudflare Blog
items.importanceReasonZh: 该功能扩展了 Workers 的网络能力，使开发者能够处理自定义 TCP 协议和 gRPC 服务，对边缘计算和微服务架构有实际影响。
items.importanceReasonEn: This feature expands Workers' networking capabilities, enabling developers to handle custom TCP protocols and gRPC services, with practical impact on edge computing and microservices architectures.
items.titleZh: Cloudflare Workers 与 Containers 现已支持入站 TCP 连接和 gRPC
items.titleEn: Cloudflare Workers and Containers Now Support Inbound TCP Connections and gRPC
items.summaryZh: Cloudflare 在 Agents Week 期间推出 Workers 运行时新处理器 connect（socket），可直接接受 Spectrum 提供的入站 TCP 套接字，并支持将套接字转发至 Durable Objects 或 Containers，实现全双工通信。
items.summaryEn: During Agents Week, Cloudflare introduced a new connect() handler in the Workers runtime that directly accepts inbound TCP sockets from Spectrum, and supports forwarding sockets to Durable Objects or Containers for full-duplex communication.
items.detailZh: Cloudflare 在 Agents Week 期间宣布，Workers 运行时现在支持通过新的 connect() 处理器直接接受入站 TCP 套接字。该处理器由 Spectrum 提供支持，允许 Workers 处理自定义 TCP 协议，包括 gRPC。连接可以转发到 Durable Objects 或 Containers，实现全双工通信。此前，Workers 仅支持 HTTP 请求，开发者需要依赖第三方服务或 Cloudflare 的 Spectrum 功能来代理 TCP 流量，但无法在 Workers 内部直接处理。现在，开发者可以在 Workers 中直接处理 TCP 连接，从而构建更广泛的网络应用。
keyPointsZh: Workers 运行时新增 connect() 处理器，可直接接受入站 TCP 套接字。
支持将 TCP 套接字转发至 Durable Objects 或 Containers。
支持 gRPC 协议，实现全双工通信。
该功能由 Spectrum 提供支持，扩展了 Workers 的网络能力。
items.impactZh: 对于开发者而言，现在可以在边缘直接处理自定义 TCP 协议和 gRPC 服务，无需额外代理或中间层。这简化了微服务架构，降低了延迟，并使得在 Workers 上构建实时通信应用成为可能。对于行业而言，Cloudflare 进一步巩固了其边缘计算平台的竞争力，为更多类型的应用提供了部署选项。

items.titleOriginal: condense-json 1.0
items.summaryOriginal: Release: condense-json 1.0 I'm trying to get braver at releasing 1.0 versions. This little library is a year and a half old now - I've applied some sensible and non-disruptive fixes and shipped the big 1.0 for it. Here's an example of what it can do, lifted from the README: { "foo" : { "bar" : { "string" : " This is a string with foxes in it " , "nested" : { "more" : [ " Here is a string " , " another with foxes in it too " ] } } } } Combine that with a replacements object: { "1" : " with foxes in it " } And condense_json(input_json, replacements) produces the following: { "foo" : { "bar" : { "string" : { "$r" : [ " This is a string " , { "$" : " 1 " }]}, "nested" : { "more" : [ " Here is a string " , { "$r" : [ " another " , { "$" : " 1 " }, " too " ]}] } } } } It scans for strings or substrings that are present in that replacements object and replaces those with a special {"$r": ...} syntax in the output. You can reverse the effect with uncondense_json(condensed, replacements) . The idea is to make it easier to store JSON that includes duplicated data from other related structures. I use it to save space in the SQLite logs generated by LLM - see PR #1586 for the latest iteration

items.titleOriginal: Learning Stateful Predictive Knowledge From Experience
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28638v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly learn from experience, they primarily rely on trajectory-level reflection to extract insights. Viewed through the lens of predictive knowledge, we argue that this approach operates on episodic hindsight rather than predictive foresight, yielding brittle, path-dependent heuristics. To address this, we propose Stateful Knowledge Learning (SKL). SKL shifts the agent's focus from trajectory-level summarization to maintaining Stateful Knowledge: explicit, declarative predictive assessments anchored to state. We first demonstrate a motivating example showing how stateful knowledge provides granularity, enhances generalization, and enables knowledge bootstrapping. To further scale up the idea, we introduce two algorithms via self-distillation (SKL-SD) and reinforcement learning (SKL-RL), training agents to autonomously extract state-grounded predictive knowledge from experience and learn to leverage it for policy making. items.importanceReasonZh: 该研究针对LLM智能体经验学习中的关键问题提出新方法，具有理论创新和实验验证，对智能体学习机制有重要影响。
items.importanceReasonEn: The research addresses a key issue in LLM agent experiential learning with a novel method, supported by experiments, with significant implications for agent learning mechanisms.
items.titleZh: 从经验中学习有状态预测知识
items.titleEn: Learning Stateful Predictive Knowledge From Experience
items.summaryZh: 本文提出状态知识学习（SKL）方法，以解决大型语言模型智能体在经验学习中依赖轨迹级反思导致的知识脆弱和路径依赖问题。SKL将焦点转向维护显式、声明性的、锚定于状态的预测知识。通过自蒸馏（SKL-SD）和强化学习（SKL-RL）两种算法，训练智能体自主提取状态基础预测知识并用于决策。在WebShop、ScienceWorld和ChessPuzzles等环境中的实验表明，该方法提升了泛化能力和知识引导能力。
items.summaryEn: This paper proposes Stateful Knowledge Learning (SKL) to address the brittleness and path-dependence of trajectory-level reflection in LLM agents' experiential learning. SKL shifts focus to maintaining explicit, declarative, state-anchored predictive knowledge. Two algorithms, SKL-SD (self-distillation) and SKL-RL (reinforcement learning), train agents to autonomously extract state-grounded predictive knowledge and use it for policy making. Experiments on WebShop, ScienceWorld, and ChessPuzzles demonstrate improved generalization and knowledge leverage.
items.detailZh:
大型语言模型智能体在从经验中学习时，通常依赖轨迹级反思来提取见解。然而，这种基于事后回顾的方法缺乏预测性，导致知识脆弱且依赖具体路径。本文提出状态知识学习（SKL），将焦点从轨迹级总结转向维护显式的、声明性的、锚定于状态的预测知识。这种知识提供了更细粒度的信息，增强了泛化能力，并支持知识引导的自我提升。

为实现这一目标，作者设计了两种算法：SKL-SD通过自蒸馏让智能体从经验中提取状态基础预测知识，SKL-RL则利用强化学习训练智能体自主提取并利用这些知识进行决策。实验在WebShop、ScienceWorld和ChessPuzzles等交互式环境及复杂推理任务上进行，结果显示SKL方法在泛化和知识利用方面优于基线。

Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. items.titleOriginal: Are the Financial Reasoning from LLMs Credible? A Real World Test over Long-Horizon Statements
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28661v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Do Large Language Models (LLMs) possess genuine structural reasoning, or merely rely on surface-level pattern matching? The financial domain, demanding numerical precision and multi-step logic over long contexts, is an ideal testbed. Existing benchmarks fail to capture real-world industrial complexity, predominantly relying on multiple-choice questions or single-hop QA over cropped tables while ignoring intricate cross-statement dynamics and temporal de-cumulation. To bridge this gap, we introduce FinIndices, a large-scale benchmark evaluating data-processing fidelity over uncropped financial statements (up to 32K tokens). Utilizing an automated synthesis pipeline with adversarial traps, FinIndices encompasses Single-Index computation and Table-Index tabulation to test complex domain, temporal, and caliber reasoning. Our evaluation reveals two severe LLM vulnerabilities. First, a "Knowledge Bottleneck": despite memorizing formulas during pre-training, models demonstrate fragile pattern matching. items.summaryZh: 本文提出了FinIndices基准，用于评估LLM在未裁剪财务报表（最长32K tokens）上的数据处理保真度。通过自动化合成流程和对抗性陷阱，FinIndices包含单指数计算和表指数制表任务，测试复杂领域、时间和量纲推理。评估发现两个严重漏洞：知识瓶颈（移除公式提示导致性能崩溃，如Gemini-3.1-Pro在表格任务上从70.70%降至38.22%）和模式匹配脆弱性。
items.summaryEn: This paper introduces FinIndices, a benchmark for evaluating LLM data-processing fidelity on uncropped financial statements (up to 32K tokens). Using an automated synthesis pipeline with adversarial traps, FinIndices includes single-index computation and table-index tabulation tasks to test complex domain, temporal, and caliber reasoning. Evaluation reveals two severe vulnerabilities: knowledge bottleneck (performance collapses without formula hints, e.g., Gemini-3.1-Pro drops from 70.70% to 38.22% on table tasks) and fragile pattern matching.
items.detailZh: 大型语言模型（LLM）是否具备真正的结构推理能力，还是仅仅依赖表面模式匹配？金融领域要求数值精度和多步逻辑，且上下文较长，是理想的测试平台。现有基准未能捕捉真实工业复杂性，主要依赖选择题或对裁剪表格的单跳问答，忽略了跨陈述动态和时间去累积等复杂因素。为弥补这一差距，研究者提出了FinIndices，一个大规模基准，用于评估在未裁剪财务报表（最长32K tokens）上的数据处理保真度。利用自动化合成流程和对抗性陷阱，FinIndices包含单指数计算和表指数制表任务，测试复杂领域、时间和量纲推理。评估揭示了两个严重的LLM漏洞：一是“知识瓶颈”，尽管模型在预训练中记住了公式，但模式匹配脆弱，移除显式公式提示会导致性能崩溃（例如，Gemini-3.1-Pro在表格任务上从70.70%降至38.22%）；二是模式匹配的脆弱性，模型可能依赖表面线索而非深层逻辑。
keyPointsZh: 提出FinIndices基准，评估LLM在未裁剪财务报表上的推理能力，最长上下文32K tokens。
基准包含单指数计算和表指数制表任务，覆盖复杂领域、时间和量纲推理。
发现知识瓶颈：移除公式提示导致性能显著下降，如Gemini-3.1-Pro在表格任务上从70.70%降至38.22%。
揭示LLM在金融推理中依赖表面模式匹配，而非真正的结构推理。
items.impactZh: 该研究对金融领域使用LLM的从业者具有警示意义，表明模型在复杂财务推理上可能不可靠，需要谨慎使用。对开发者而言，提示工程（如提供公式）可能暂时提升性能，但模型缺乏鲁棒性。对行业而言，需要开发更稳健的评估基准和训练方法，以增强模型的结构推理能力。

items.titleOriginal: The Checking Problem: What must be true before AI ships in a regulated firm
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28666v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise AI programmes stall at a rate that is widely quoted and poorly explained. This paper measures the mechanism. Six document-heavy workflows of the kind performed daily in regulated financial services were run across four model families and three tool configurations, three times each, producing 5,093 scored output elements across 72 configurations. Each configuration was assessed twice: against a demonstration bar, being a single correct run on a single case, and against a production bar requiring sustained accuracy, reproducibility across repeats, verifiable attribution, and a confidence signal that carries information. 57 of 72 configurations cleared the demonstration bar and 32 cleared the production bar, a survival rate of 56.1%. The paper then computes the review burden each configuration imposes, estimated out of sample rather than with hindsight. A tool that states no confidence requires review of 100% of its output, because it offers a reviewer no basis for triage. 该研究针对企业AI项目停滞率高的问题，通过实验测量了其机制。实验在受监管金融服务中选取了六个文档密集型工作流，使用四个模型家族和三种工具配置，每种配置运行三次，共产生5,093个评分输出元素，覆盖72种配置。每种配置分别针对演示标准（单案例单次正确运行）和生产标准（持续准确性、重复可复现性、可验证归因、信息量置信信号）进行评估。结果显示，72种配置中57种通过演示标准，但只有32种通过生产标准，存活率仅为56.1%，表明演示成功并不等于生产可用。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28680v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Entity linking in tables matches short and ambiguous cell mentions to their corresponding knowledge-base entities. Existing approaches typically rely on data preprocessing pipelines that retain either compact or extensive table content as contextual evidence, and then formulate entity linking as a language generation task for instruction-tuned models; recent systems further incorporate explicit reasoning to disambiguate challenging mentions. However, their training supervision is usually static: fixed preference data cannot adapt to the residual errors of an evolving model, while variations in reasoning length can bias sequence-level preference learning. We first retrieve and rank Wikidata candidates and retain reduced table evidence in the prompt. items.detailZh:
该论文介绍了一种名为TELLER的新方法，用于表格实体链接任务。表格实体链接旨在将表格中的单元格提及与知识库中的实体进行匹配，这是一个具有挑战性的任务，因为提及通常简短且模糊。现有方法通常依赖于数据预处理流程，保留紧凑或广泛的表格内容作为上下文证据，然后将实体链接视为语言生成任务。然而，这些方法的训练监督通常是静态的，无法适应模型的持续改进，并且推理长度的变化可能会影响序列级偏好学习。

TELLER方法通过两个路径来解决这些问题：直接答案路径和推理路径。在直接答案路径中，使用迭代直接偏好优化（iterative DPO）来训练模型，并不断用更新模型的残余错误刷新偏好数据。在推理路径中，使用过滤和压缩的思维链理由进行监督微调，然后进行迭代优化。该方法首先检索并排序Wikidata候选，并在提示中保留缩减的表格证据。

论文的摘要部分被截断，但可以推断出TELLER在表格实体链接任务上取得了显著的性能提升。该研究为表格实体链接提供了一种新的训练范式，可能对相关领域的研究产生重要影响。

items.titleOriginal: Imbalanced Data Clustering via Targeted Data Augmentation Using GMM and LLM
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28635v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Natural Language Processing (NLP), dealing with underrepresented topics is challenging, especially in unsupervised tasks where clustering might not adequately capture minority topics. To tackle this challenge, our paper presents a novel unsupervised data augmentation method that integrates Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs). Due to their flexibility and robustness, GMMs can detect clusters corresponding to underrepresented areas in the data, while LLMs create synthetic documents to enrich these clusters and improve their representation. Experiments on various imbalanced text datasets demonstrate that our approach preserves clustering performance in all cases and often enhances cluster interpretability, offering a robust and scalable solution for improving data representation in unsupervised NLP tasks.

items.titleOriginal: Chain-of-Models: Cross-Model Auditing for Bias-Robust LLM Judges
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28636v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: LLMs increasingly serve as automated judges, but their judgments remain vulnerable to cognitive biases. Existing mitigations mostly rely on prompt-driven debiasing, which is brittle across bias types, or human evaluation, which does not scale. We study \emph{Chain-of-Models} (CoM), an automated audit pipeline in which a second model inspects the first model's reasoning trace before producing the final judgment. The key design question is whether the auditor should be the same model, a same-family model, or a different-family model. Across 9 models from 6 families, 4 cognitive biases, and 4 factual datasets, we find that auditor identity matters in two ways. Second, the best auditor is bias-specific: GPT-4o is strongest on bandwagon, authority, and distraction, while GLM-5 is strongest on sycophancy. items.titleOriginal: ZeroR@CHiPSAL 2026: Two-Stage Vision-Language Adaptation with Contrastive Learning for Nepali Meme Classification
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28637v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents our system for the CHiPSAL 2026 shared task on multimodal hate speech and sentiment detection in Nepali memes. We address both subtasks: binary hate speech classification and three-class sentiment analysis. Our approach adapts the Robust Adaptation of Hateful Meme Detection (RA-HMD) framework using Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct, a state-of-the-art vision-language model with native Devanagari support. We employ a two-stage training pipeline: (1) LoRA fine-tuning with an MLP projection head for generative classification, and (2) contrastive backbone fine-tuning with supervised InfoNCE loss. We handle class imbalance through minority oversampling, image augmentation, and focal loss. At inference, we ensemble Stage 1 token probabilities with Stage 2 classifier scores using validation-tuned weights. Our end-to-end approach eliminates error propagation from separate OCR and translation pipelines by leveraging the model's native Devanagari understanding. items.titleOriginal: DragonCrawl: A Generative, Intent-Based Framework for Scalable Mobile End-to-End Testing
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28750v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As mobile applications grow in complexity, traditional End-to-End (E2E) testing frameworks struggle with UI volatility, maintenance overhead, and cross-platform scalability. This paper presents DragonCrawl, an AI-driven mobile testing system for continuous regression testing that has evolved from embedding-based similarity matching to generative intent-based reasoning using large language models. Unlike prior LLM-based testing research focused on exploratory testing and crash detection, DragonCrawl validates specific user flows on every code change, blocking commits that break critical functionality. By leveraging GPT-4o's multimodal capabilities, DragonCrawl achieves 91.6% pass rate on iOS and 92.2% on Android across 1,013 automated tests running continuously in CI/CD pipelines. The system reduces test onboarding time from 96-120 hours to under 4 hours and has saved an estimated 27 developer years in test maintenance effort. items.titleOriginal: SCMA: Structure-Conditioned and Metal-Aware Flow Matching for CT Metal Artifact Reduction
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28759v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In X-ray CT, metallic objects cause beam hardening, photon starvation, and scattering, leading to projection inconsistency, streaks, dark bands, and structural distortions that compromise clinical diagnosis and quantitative analysis. Existing metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods remain limited: optimization-based methods may leave residual artifacts or blur structures, regression networks may generalize poorly across scenarios, and generative models without sample-specific structural guidance and physical constraints may produce anatomically inconsistent structures. Flow Matching learns a continuous-time velocity field that deterministically transports a source distribution to a target distribution, providing a flexible MAR prior. However, standard unconditional Flow Matching does not exploit sample-specific structure, spatially nonuniform metal-induced degradation, or measured projections. To address these limitations, we propose SCMA, a structure-conditioned and metal-aware Flow Matching framework. items.titleEn: SCMA: Structure-Conditioned and Metal-Aware Flow Matching for CT Metal Artifact Reduction
items.summaryZh: arXiv:2607.28759v1 公告类型：交叉摘要。在X射线CT中，金属物体导致束硬化、光子饥饿和散射，引起投影不一致、条纹、暗带和结构变形，影响临床诊断和定量分析。现有金属伪影减少（MAR）方法存在局限：基于优化的方法可能留下残余伪影或模糊结构，回归网络可能泛化不佳，无样本特定结构指导和物理约束的生成模型可能产生解剖结构不一致。流匹配学习连续时间速度场，将源分布确定性传输到目标分布，提供灵活的MAR先验。然而，标准无条件流匹配未利用样本特定结构、空间非均匀金属退化或测量投影。为解决这些限制，我们提出SCMA，一种结构条件与金属感知的流匹配框架。首先，线性插值校正图像与中间状态作为样本特定结构输入速度网络。
items.summaryEn: arXiv:2607.28759v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In X-ray CT, metallic objects cause beam hardening, photon starvation, and scattering, leading to projection inconsistency, streaks, dark bands, and structural distortions that compromise clinical diagnosis and quantitative analysis. Existing metal artifact reduction (MAR) methods remain limited: optimization-based methods may leave residual artifacts or blur structures, regression networks may generalize poorly across scenarios, and generative models without sample-specific structural guidance and physical constraints may produce anatomically inconsistent structures. items.detailZh: 该论文提出了一种名为SCMA的框架，用于减少CT图像中的金属伪影。金属伪影由金属物体引起的束硬化、光子饥饿和散射等现象导致，表现为投影不一致、条纹、暗带和结构变形，影响临床诊断。现有方法包括基于优化的方法、回归网络和生成模型，但各有局限。流匹配是一种生成模型，通过学习连续时间速度场将源分布映射到目标分布，可作为MAR的先验。然而，标准流匹配未利用样本特定结构、金属引起的空间非均匀退化以及测量投影。SCMA通过将线性插值校正图像与中间状态作为样本特定结构输入速度网络，并引入金属感知机制，以更好地处理金属伪影。论文可能包含实验验证，但摘要未提供具体结果。
keyPointsZh: SCMA是一种结构条件与金属感知的流匹配框架，用于CT金属伪影减少。
现有MAR方法存在残余伪影、泛化差或结构不一致等问题。
流匹配提供灵活的MAR先验，但标准流匹配未利用样本特定信息。
SCMA将线性插值校正图像与中间状态作为结构条件，并引入金属感知。
items.impactZh: 该研究可能为CT金属伪影减少提供新的生成式方法，改善临床图像质量，提高诊断准确性。对于医学影像处理领域的研究者和开发者，该方法可能启发新的研究方向，并可能应用于临床CT系统。

items.titleOriginal: WaiT for the Signal: Simple Frequency-Aware Flow-Matching
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28760v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: As image generation models scale to ever higher resolutions, global coherence, local detail, and texture fidelity become critical axes for generation quality. However, standard flow matching treats all spatial frequencies uniformly, ignoring the natural frequency hierarchy where high-frequency bands become indistinguishable from pure noise far earlier than coarse structures. We introduce WaiT, a Wavelet-aware image Transformer that decomposes generation into coarse and fine bands via lossless wavelets. True to its name, the high-frequency bands wait for the signal: staying pure noise until coarse structure has emerged, then joining the flow for joint refinement. Since standard FID discards fine-grained detail through aggressive downsampling, we introduce a more stringent three-axis evaluation protocol to assess quality at native resolution. On ImageNet 512x512, WaiT achieves a pixel-space FID of 1.43 and is Pareto-optimal across all three axes, reducing sampling compute by up to 50%. items.titleOriginal: Stratified Negation in RDF Rules: A Correct Approach (Extended Version)
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28778v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Combining RDF rule languages, such as N3 or SHACL Rules, with default negation is challenging. Existing methods to stratify negation often fail for RDF rules, since individual triples do not carry enough information to meaningfully restrict potential dependencies. Blank nodes in rule heads further complicate the matter, since the order of rule applications may determine whether new values are created, which in turn can change the applicability of rules with negation. To solve these open problems, we propose chain stratification as a robust new condition that guarantees a well-behaved semantics for RDF rules with negation, and existential rules in general. Our condition combines an elaborate analysis of potential multistep derivations with a mechanism for using integrity constraints to discard impossible cases. Applying rules in any order that respects chain stratification is guaranteed to derive an RDF graph that is unique, lean, and justified under the usual negation-as-failure semantics. To show the practicality, we also provide a prototype implementation.
items.author: Nils K\"uchenmeister, Alex Ivliev, D\"orthe Arndt, Markus Kr\"otzsch
items.importanceReasonZh: 该研究解决了RDF规则与默认否定结合中的关键理论问题，提出了新的分层条件，并提供了原型实现，对语义网和规则推理领域有重要贡献。

items.titleOriginal: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Benchmark datasets are central to evaluating Large Language Models (LLMs), yet they are typically conceived as monolithic tasks, obscuring substantial variation in the demands of individual samples. We introduce a dataset-centric meta-evaluation framework that audits benchmark datasets at the sample level along five latent dimensions: 1. Cognitive and Knowledge Demands, 2. Language and Content Quality, 3. Task Properties, 4. Context, and 5. Ethics, Safety, and Fairness. Applying this framework, we annotate five influential benchmarks -- MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, and TruthfulQA -- revealing pronounced internal heterogeneity that is not captured by aggregate accuracy scores. We show how these annotations enable criterion-driven orchestration of composite benchmark subsets across datasets, supporting targeted evaluation of model capabilities such as Reasoning Depth or Ethical Sensitivity. This approach reframes benchmark evaluation as dataset introspection, providing a principled methodology for analyzing and re-composing existing benchmarks to better reflect diverse evaluation needs.
items.author: Philipp D. Siedler, Jordan Sassoon
items.importanceReasonZh: 该研究提出了一种新颖的基准测试审计方法，有助于更细致地理解模型能力，对评估实践有潜在影响，但尚未经过广泛验证。
items.importanceReasonEn: The research proposes a novel benchmark auditing method that could lead to more nuanced model evaluation, with potential impact on evaluation practices, but it is not yet widely validated.
items.titleZh: 基准测试并非铁板一块：面向LLM评估的样本级审计与编排
items.titleEn: Benchmarks Are Not Monolithic: Sample-Level Auditing and Orchestration for LLM Evaluation
items.summaryZh: 该论文提出一个以数据集为中心的元评估框架，在样本级别对基准数据集进行审计，涵盖五个潜在维度：认知与知识需求、语言与内容质量、任务属性、上下文以及伦理、安全与公平性。作者对MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和TruthfulQA五个基准进行了标注，揭示了聚合准确率无法捕捉的内部异质性，并展示了如何利用这些标注实现跨数据集的组合子集编排，以支持针对模型能力（如推理深度或伦理敏感性）的定向评估。
items.summaryEn: This paper introduces a dataset-centric meta-evaluation framework that audits benchmark datasets at the sample level along five latent dimensions: cognitive and knowledge demands, language and content quality, task properties, context, and ethics, safety, and fairness. The authors annotate five benchmarks (MMLU, ARC, WinoGrande, HellaSwag, TruthfulQA), revealing internal heterogeneity not captured by aggregate accuracy, and demonstrate how these annotations enable criterion-driven orchestration of composite subsets across datasets for targeted evaluation of capabilities like reasoning depth or ethical sensitivity.
items.detailZh:
该论文指出，基准数据集通常被视为单一任务，掩盖了单个样本需求的显著差异。为此，作者提出了一个以数据集为中心的元评估框架，在样本级别对基准进行审计，涵盖五个潜在维度：认知与知识需求、语言与内容质量、任务属性、上下文以及伦理、安全与公平性。他们将该框架应用于五个有影响力的基准（MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和TruthfulQA），并进行了标注，揭示了这些基准内部存在显著的异质性，而这种异质性无法通过聚合准确率分数体现。

基于这些标注，作者展示了如何实现跨数据集的组合子集编排，以支持针对特定模型能力（如推理深度或伦理敏感性）的定向评估。这种方法将基准评估重新定义为数据集内省，为分析和重新组合现有基准以更好地反映多样化评估需求提供了原则性方法论。

该研究来自arXiv预印本，属于交叉领域，可能对评估方法论和基准设计有参考价值。然而，由于是预印本，尚未经过同行评审，其框架的有效性和实用性有待进一步验证。
keyPointsZh: 提出样本级基准审计框架，涵盖五个潜在维度。
对MMLU、ARC、WinoGrande、HellaSwag和TruthfulQA进行标注，揭示内部异质性。
展示如何利用标注进行跨数据集编排，实现定向评估。
将基准评估重新定义为数据集内省。
items.impactZh: 该研究可能影响LLM评估实践，使评估更加细致和针对性。对于开发者而言，可以更准确地识别模型在特定能力上的强弱，从而指导模型改进。对于行业而言，可能推动更精细的基准设计和评估标准。

items.titleOriginal: Rolling With Resistance: Preference-Optimized LLM Counselors Can Trade Goal Persistence for Relational Attunement in Motivational Interviewing
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28814v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In Motivational Interviewing (MI), a client's sustain talk (arguments for the status quo) calls for the counselor to roll with resistance, a move that can fail in two opposite ways: capitulation (abandoning the change agenda to preserve rapport) or confrontation (arguing or directing, overriding the client's autonomy). We introduce a two-axis evaluation of counselor responses, anchored in the Motivational Interviewing Treatment Integrity (MITI) code, Goal Persistence (GP) and Relational Attunement (RA), yielding a four-quadrant framing in which rolling with resistance is high on both, and we ask whether penalizing one failure through preference optimization teaches rolling with resistance or provokes its opposite. From the expert-annotated AnnoMI corpus we build topic-disjoint Direct Preference Optimization data whose preference sets differ only in which failure is rejected, using on-policy negatives. An automatic judge, validated against AnnoMI's expert labels and rechecked by trained human coders, scores blind pairwise win-rates against each base under a firewall in which disjoint model families generate, label, and judge. items.titleZh: 与阻力共舞：偏好优化的LLM咨询师在动机性访谈中可权衡目标坚持与关系调谐
items.titleEn: Rolling With Resistance: Preference-Optimized LLM Counselors Can Trade Goal Persistence for Relational Attunement in Motivational Interviewing
items.summaryZh: 在动机性访谈中，来访者的维持性谈话（为现状辩护）要求咨询师“与阻力共舞”，这一动作可能以两种相反方式失败：屈服（放弃改变议程以维持关系）或对抗（争辩或指导，侵犯来访者自主性）。我们引入基于MITI编码的双轴评估：目标坚持（GP）和关系调谐（RA），形成四象限框架，其中“与阻力共舞”在两者上均高。我们询问通过偏好优化惩罚一种失败，是教会模型“与阻力共舞”还是引发其反面。从专家标注的AnnoMI语料库构建主题不相交的DPO数据，其偏好集仅在被拒绝的失败类型上不同，使用on-policy负样本。自动评判器（经AnnoMI专家标签验证并由训练有素的人类编码员复核）在防火墙下对每个基础模型进行盲法成对胜率评分，其中不相交的模型家族负责生成、标注和评判。
items.summaryEn: In Motivational Interviewing (MI), a client's sustain talk calls for the counselor to roll with resistance, a move that can fail in two opposite ways: capitulation or confrontation. We introduce a two-axis evaluation of counselor responses, anchored in the MITI code, Goal Persistence (GP) and Relational Attunement (RA), yielding a four-quadrant framing. We ask whether penalizing one failure through preference optimization teaches rolling with resistance or provokes its opposite. From the AnnoMI corpus we build topic-disjoint DPO data with on-policy negatives. An automatic judge, validated against expert labels and rechecked by human coders, scores blind pairwise win-rates under a firewall with disjoint model families.
items.detailZh: 该研究关注动机性访谈中咨询师对来访者维持性谈话的回应。在MI中，当来访者表达维持现状的理由时，咨询师应“与阻力共舞”，即既保持目标坚持（推动改变）又保持关系调谐（尊重自主性）。然而，模型可能倾向于两种失败模式：屈服（完全放弃改变目标）或对抗（强行说服）。研究者提出用双轴评估（GP和RA）来刻画回应质量，并探讨通过偏好优化（DPO）惩罚一种失败是否会导致另一种失败。他们从AnnoMI语料库构建了主题不相交的DPO数据，使用on-policy负样本，并采用自动评判器（经专家验证）进行盲法评估。实验在防火墙设计下进行，确保生成、标注和评判的模型家族不相交，以避免偏差。

采用防火墙设计，模型家族不相交以增强评估可靠性。
items.impactZh: 该研究为LLM在心理咨询等敏感领域的对齐提供了新视角，强调在目标坚持和关系调谐之间取得平衡。对开发者而言，提示了偏好优化可能带来的副作用，需要谨慎设计奖励函数。对行业而言，有助于开发更符合伦理的AI咨询工具。

items.titleOriginal: Hypergradient-based Bilevel Reinforcement Learning with Improved Sample Complexity
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28849v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bilevel reinforcement learning (RL) is an important framework within the literature of RL that can be used to formalize various categories of problems, such as meta-learning, hierarchical task decomposition, and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RL-HF). Most of the bilevel RL algorithms are either not scalable because of using hypergradient with Hessian, or they suffer from high sample complexity because of using penalty-based approximation methods. In this work, we propose a hypergradient-based bilevel RL algorithm using the optimality of the Boltzmann policy for the entropy regularized discounted RL objective function. Our proposed algorithm is Hessian-free and obtains an iteration complexity of $O(\epsilon^{-1})$ and state-of-the-art sample complexity of $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ under mild regularity conditions. Further, in our convergence analysis, we are able to remove the assumption of the Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition on the outer-level objective function present in the prior state-of-the-art sample complexity work.

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28862v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs) has led to significant advances across a wide range of language tasks, while simultaneously raising growing concerns about unauthorized data exploitation and privacy leakage. Unlearnable examples (UEs) offer a promising defense by introducing carefully designed perturbations into data such that models trained on them exhibit degraded utility. TextCloak employs a generative policy that transforms batches of clean text into unlearnable examples while preserving semantic fidelity and linguistic naturalness. items.titleOriginal: Validation Evidence in LLM Repair Agents: How Much of What Passes Actually Tests the Bug?
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28871v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When a repair agent runs a test and sees it pass, the result is treated as evidence about the reported defect. We measure how often that treatment is warranted. BSG-VA (buggy-state/candidate-state/gold-fix validation analysis) captures each validation command at its exact working-tree state, extracts a test-only patch, and replays the command on the original buggy code (B), the candidate state (S), and the developer gold fix (G). The captured outcome and the replay results assign every event an evidence role, from gold-aligned bug-discriminating through regression-only to misleading. Across 3,730 events in 643 rollouts on 110 tasks, 46.0% of positive comparable events carry no bug-discriminating information; 23.8% of baseline rollouts, with no feedback injected, close with a patch whose entire positive evidence base is of this kind. A three-arm experiment tests whether returning the B-replay outcome to the agent changes this pattern. Bug-contrast feedback reduces evidence-inadequate closure by 7.8 percentage points relative to an attention-matched reminder (p = 0.0029) and raises bug-discriminating evidence by 7.4 points (p = 0.011)

items.titleOriginal: RareSense: Rarity-Aware Similarity Search for Anomaly Retrieval in Transactional Data
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28879v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Similarity search over sparse set-valued data is often dominated by frequent background attributes because classical measures such as Jaccard, cosine, and Hamming compare objects through atomic overlap. IDF (Inverse document frequency) weighting partially reduces this effect but remains atom-wise and cannot explicitly represent informative higher-order co-occurrences. We introduce RareSense, a rarity-aware similarity framework for sparse transactional anomaly data. RareSense mines minimal rare itemsets as intermediate structures, derives reliable rare association rules, maps objects into sparse rare-rule profiles, and compares them using weighted Jaccard similarity. Rule weights combine inverse support, confidence, lift, structural complexity, and stability, so that neighborhoods are determined by shared rare evidence rather than uniform feature overlap. We show that IDF-weighted Jaccard is a restricted singleton case of RareSense, and that the induced distance is a pseudometric on the original objects and a metric over equivalence classes defined by identical rule profiles. items.titleOriginal: To Add Is Machine, To Delete Is Human: Measuring and Mitigating Deletion Avoidance in LLM Code Editing
items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28887v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models increasingly write and repair production code, yet evidence is mounting that their test-passing patches leave codebases harder to maintain. We identify one concrete source: deletion avoidance, the systematic tendency to retain code that an intended edit requires removing. Across the five leading models on the official SWE-bench Verified leaderboard, deletion recall against the developer patch reaches at most 71.7% even on tasks all five solve, and models reach the right file for over 92% of required deletions but cut the exact line in under 52% of cases. Instead, 29.0% of passing patches wrap the targeted code in a guard or fallback, a pattern we call Guard-and-Go. Such patches pass because the original tests rarely check removal: when we retrofit 34 Verified tasks with tests that fail if the targeted code remains, four frontier models spanning closed and open weights fall from 63.2% to 41.9%. Because real repairs mix removal with addition, we curate CanItDelete, a benchmark of 200 tasks mined from real commits whose entire required edit is deletion. items.importanceReasonEn: This research reveals an important and overlooked issue: LLMs tend to avoid deleting code in edits, leading to patches that pass tests but increase maintenance burden. It provides quantitative evidence and a benchmark, with significant implications for code generation.

items.detailZh: 该论文指出，大型语言模型在代码编辑任务中表现出“删除回避”倾向，即系统性地保留本应删除的代码。在SWE-bench Verified排行榜上的五个领先模型上，删除召回率最高仅为71.7%，即使所有模型都解决了任务。模型在超过92%的必需删除中定位到了正确的文件，但在不到52%的情况下精确删除了目标行。相反，29.0%的通过补丁采用了“守卫并继续”模式，即用条件语句包裹目标代码而不是删除它。这种补丁能通过原始测试，因为测试很少检查代码是否被删除。当研究人员为34个任务添加了针对删除的测试后，四个前沿模型的通过率从63.2%下降到41.9%。为了进一步研究，他们构建了CanItDelete基准，包含200个从真实提交中挖掘的、仅需删除操作的任务。即使在这些纯删除任务中，最佳模型的表现仍然不佳，表明删除回避是系统性的问题。

29.0%的通过补丁采用守卫或回退模式而非删除代码。
添加针对删除的测试后，模型通过率从63.2%降至41.9%。
构建了CanItDelete基准，包含200个纯删除任务，模型表现不佳。
items.impactZh: 该研究对依赖LLM进行代码修复的开发者有直接影响：即使补丁通过测试，也可能留下冗余代码，增加维护成本。对AI代码生成领域而言，需要改进训练目标和评估方法，以鼓励模型正确执行删除操作。

items.summaryOriginal: arXiv:2607.28889v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Qualitative researchers increasingly encounter interaction corpora whose scale exceeds what manual coding alone can address, and large language models (LLMs) are frequently proposed as analytic assistants. The open questions are not whether LLMs can participate in qualitative analysis but to what extent, in what phases, and under what safeguards. This article provides a detailed procedural account of a multi-phase human-LLM collaborative pipeline that adapted open, axial, and selective coding to develop a hierarchical codebook from 45,000 messages exchanged between K-12 educators and a generative AI platform. Across three phases, LLMs generated candidate labels and structured annotations at scale, while human researchers retained conceptual authority over category definitions, merging decisions, and interpretive frameworks. items.detailZh:
该研究针对定性研究者面临的大规模交互语料（如45,000条消息）超出人工编码能力的问题，提出了一种多阶段人机协作流水线。该方法改编了传统的开放编码、轴向编码和选择性编码，利用LLM生成候选标签和结构化注释，同时人类研究者保留对类别定义、合并决策和解释框架的最终控制权。具体流程分为三个阶段：第一阶段，LLM辅助进行开放编码，生成初步标签；第二阶段，人类研究者与LLM协作进行轴向编码，整合和细化类别；第三阶段，进行选择性编码，形成层次化编码本。

为了验证编码本的可靠性，研究者让三名具有教育领域专业知识的编码员将其应用于独立的2,560条消息样本，并使用适用于多标签编码的集合值一致性度量进行迭代校准。结果表明，该编码本在人类编码员之间达到了可接受的可靠性。该研究详细记录了每个阶段的步骤、决策和挑战，为其他研究者提供了可复制的流程。
keyPointsZh: 提出了一种多阶段人机协作编码流水线，结合LLM的规模化处理与人类的概念权威。
从45,000条K-12教育者与AI平台的交互消息中开发出层次化编码本。
通过三名训练有素的编码员对2,560条消息的独立样本进行测试，并采用集合值一致性度量建立可靠性。
详细记录了流程步骤，为定性研究者提供了可复制的参考。
items.impactZh: 该研究为定性研究者提供了一种处理大规模交互语料的实用方法，通过人机协作提高编码效率，同时保持人类对概念框架的控制。对AI辅助定性分析领域具有方法论贡献，可能推动更多研究者采用LLM作为分析助手。
